entities.summary: Filippo Paulucci delle Roncole, also known as Filipp Osipovich Pauluchchi, was an Italian marquis and army officer, later a general at the services of the Kingdom of Sardinia, the Holy Roman Empire, the Kingdom of Italy, and the Russian Empire.
